evidence.quote: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a liquid discharge head which realizes a high density driving circuit and wiring and secures high reliability, an image forming device and a method of manufacturing the liquid discharge head.

PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a liquid droplet discharging head and an image forming apparatus which can efficiently transmit a pressure generated by a piezoelectric element to a liquid inside a pressure chamber and can efficiently discharge liquid droplets.
A rotary atomizing head for an atomizer having a cup-shaped rotary atomizing head body mounted on the front end of a rotary shaft.
